headline: Grumpy Walrus sold 5,000 ASCEND for ~5.53k ADA at 3:59 PM ET (about 1.5% of its bag, ~335.1k left), plus ~273k SNEK (~783 ADA), 3M CLOVE-3 (~612 ADA) and 3M BOLT (~567 ADA), then sent 6,000 ADA to an outside wallet at 4:05 PM (and 600 ADA at 3:20 PM). It kept stacking NIGHT: ~4.49k for ~1,000 ADA at 2:44 PM plus 500k MEPE and 250k SNEK swapped in (~9.07k NIGHT added). Net ADA ~-130 after the 6.6k sent out. ASCEND side ~1.049M, still ~40% above its line. COCK side ~142.4k, 5.0% under its line. CITY pool side down to ~11.0k. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: a 5k ASCEND sale is only ~1.5% of the bag, but paired with 6.6k ADA sent to an outside wallet it reads as profit-taking, so the 72h net-buy check for EST-01 can flip on a single sale.
